stories.headline: Mary Rivera, 'Spider-Man: No Way Home' Actress, Dead at 82 - TMZ
stories.summary: Mary Rivera, who played Ned Leeds' Filipino grandmother in "Spider-Man: No Way Home," has died ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: A supporting player's death in a massive MCU hit underscores how even minor roles become part of cultural touchstones you'll reference for decades.

stories.headline: 'A Toxic Love Story' Ian Diaz's Stepfather Begged Judge for Mercy, Read Letter to Court - TMZ
stories.summary: Ian Diaz's stepfather asked a federal judge to show compassion when it came time to sentence the former law enforcement officer featured in Netflix's "A Toxic Love Story" ... arguing prison would dev…
stories.why: This Netflix true-crime doc normalized watching abusive relationships as entertainment, and now the perpetrator's family is seeking sympathy—it's the dark mirror of how you consume these stories.

stories.headline: 'Young and the Restless' Alum Brenda Dickson Allegedly Hit Neighbor's Kid In Face - TMZ
stories.summary: The man accusing Brenda Dickson of assault is seeking court-ordered protection ... claiming the actress got physical with his child.
stories.why: A soap opera icon facing assault charges shows how celebrities from your parents' generation are aging into irrelevance and sometimes legal trouble, a cautionary arc playing out in real time.

stories.headline: CBS Greenlights 'Hilda! (In Lights!)' Comedy Pilot About 70-Year-Old Pursuing Broadway Dream - Deadline
stories.summary: CBS had ordered single-camera comedy pilot 'Hilda! (In Lights!)', about a 70-year-old woman pursuing her Broadway dream, for 2027-28 consideration.
stories.why: CBS betting on a 70-year-old pursuing dreams signals networks are finally diversifying beyond 25-year-old protagonists, which means the stories available to you are expanding as you age.

stories.headline: Christina Applegate Back Home From Hospital After Lengthy Stay, Doing Well - TMZ
stories.summary: Christina Applegate is back home after a nearly four-month hospital stay ... TMZ has learned.
stories.why: Applegate's near-death hospital stay and recovery is culturally significant because she's been transparent about her MS diagnosis—normalizing that high-achieving people cope with serious illness quietly.

stories.headline: ‘Hadestown’ Parts Ways With Actor Geno Segers After Online Outrage - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: Segers had initially been announced as part of the upcoming cast, but the news quickly drew backlash online.
stories.why: The speed of online pile-ons killing casting announcements shows cancel culture now operates as pre-emptive industry gatekeeping, not just accountability.

stories.headline: Nepo Baby Reveals Wild On-Set Clash With ‘Psychopath’ Actor - The Daily Beast
stories.summary: Scott Eastwood said the star is “clearly tormented.”
stories.why: Eastwood's 'psychopath' comment about a co-star signals that toxic on-set behavior is being publicly called out by peers now instead of quietly managed, a real shift in power dynamics.

stories.headline: Dave Bautista Eyes ‘God of War’ Lead Role as Kratos - The Hollywood Reporter
stories.summary: The 'Guardians of the Galaxy' actor is in talks to replace Ryan Hurst in the Prime Video series.
stories.why: A 56-year-old action star being seriously considered for a major streaming franchise lead suggests Hollywood is finally aging up its hero casting, breaking the 20-year stranglehold of ageless CGI bodies.
